attempts.raw: BYOK stands for Bring Your Own Key, which refers to the practice of using a user's own cryptographic key rather than a pre-generated key for accessing a service or resource. This approach allows users to have more control over their security and privacy, as they can choose their own encryption algorithm and key length.
